Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The whole manual carries an old content-currency date (stated in part A), so any rule here may have changed since; the freshness debt in part A covers every fact in this section.
The knowledge test topic split is described by the manual itself as approximate, so it is taught as an expected rough split, not an official blueprint [A01].
The late-arrival rule is worded as more than five minutes on one page [A02] and as five or more minutes on the testing-tips page [A04]; both pages are cited separately and the stricter wording is flagged (verify TN-EXAM-D-LATE).
The test-requirements table and the road test retest table extracted column by column; each row was matched only where its order was unambiguous [A01].
Appointment systems, phone numbers, the online proctored test program and the language list are service details that can change and are isolated as dynamic.
